title: IIIXII 8xplus
description: This resource pack simplifies block, entity, and other textures to 8x8, while adding several quality-of-life visual tweaks like powder snow warnings, Conspicuous minerals, Higher Contrast, etc.
body:
This resource pack simplifies block, entity, and other textures to 8x8, while adding several quality-of-life visual tweaks:

- Powder snow warnings – clear visual indicators to avoid accidental falls.
- Mineral outline hints – makes ores easier to spot.
- Blue ancient debris – stands out from surrounding netherrack.
- Higher contrast GUI – improved readability.

Why weren't chests modified? Because modifying chests would cause rendering errors when using the Better Block Entity mod.

Item textures are kept at original resolution, because scaling them down to 8x8 makes them too blurry and hard to recognize.

With these changes, you can easily spot minerals – especially ancient debris – without missing them. You also won't accidentally step into powder snow (unless you really mean to).

Since most of the work was done with automated tools, there may be minor imperfections. Feedback is very welcome!

📧 Email: xzh13559588685@yeah.net

My modpack [Extreme Optimization](https://modrinth.com/modpack/extreme_optimization) is recommened.

---
中文版本：

本资源包将方块、实体等贴图简化为 8x8 分辨率，并增加了多项实用视觉优化：

- 细雪警示 – 清晰标识，避免误入。
- 矿物边框提示 – 让矿石更容易被发现。
- 蓝色远古残骸 – 与周围下界岩形成鲜明对比。
- 高对比度 GUI – 提升界面可读性。

为什么没有修改箱子？因为修改箱子后在使用Better Block Entity模组时会发生渲染错误

物品贴图保持原版分辨率不变，因为压缩到 8x8 后会过于模糊，难以辨认。

通过这些改进，你可以轻松发现矿物，尤其是远古残骸，不再错过。同时也不会意外掉进细雪里——除非你故意为之。

由于大部分修改由自动化工具完成，可能存在少量瑕疵。欢迎反馈意见！
